text:
ashley: Heads up — seeing intermittent QoS spikes on awq-quantized llama-2-13b canary. Latency jitter + occasional token dropouts starting ~06:20 UTC. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/g/awq-canary/184234
mike: how consistent? same group_size? any recent config changes?
ashley: started after we flipped act-quant to 'aggressive' and bumped group_size from 32 -> 64 yesterday night. spikes ~every 30-90s, lasts 5-10s.
sophia: hmm we've seen similar when group crosses power-of-two boundary. can you paste a sample log snippet?
ashley: sure:
```
[2026-03-19T06:21:14Z] WARN awq_runner.cpp:235 kvcache_miss=true seq=1024 group=64 latency_ms=512
[2026-03-19T06:21:14Z] ERROR decode.cc:112 token_drop=true reason=softmax_overflow
[2026-03-19T06:21:15Z] INFO awq_infer: fallback_to_fp16=true
```
cheng: softmax_overflow + kvcache_miss pattern suggests act-scale underflow when micro-batch combines with continuous batching. act-quant aggressive uses per-group scaling; at larger groups scale variance rises.
eva: can we rollback to group_size=32 on canary? want to isolate config.
deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-19T06:25 (id=canary-7291) deployed: group_size=32, act_quant=balanced. Health: passing ✅
mike: put together quick AB test: A=group=64,act=aggressive; B=group=32,act=balanced. 10m window, capture token-drop, p50/p95 latency, and decode-failure rate.
sophia: add KV-prefetch=true to both arms to control for cache warmup.
ashley: started AB at 06:34. early numbers: A token-drop 0.9%, p95 latency 620ms; B token-drop 0.03%, p95 210ms.
cheng: confirms hypothesis. fix options:
- clamp act-scale per-layer to avoid underflow
- reduce group_size or introduce dynamic group stepping based on sequence length
- add small epsilon to softmax input in quant path
sophia: I can prototype clamp and epsilon in awq runtime. patch idea:
```
// awq_activation.cc
float scale = max(layer_scale, 1e-6f);
val = (val * scale) + 1e-6f;
```
mike: how risky? any perf hit?
sophia: negligible cost, but needs bake on canary.
eva: go ahead. deploy to canary-7292 with same AB matrix.
deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-19T07:02 (id=canary-7292) deployed: runtime-clamp=yes. Health: partial (restarting one instance) ⚠️
ashley: after patch, AB early: A token-drop 0.08%, p95 230ms; B 0.03% p95 210ms. Jitter reduced.
cheng: tradeoff seems small. let's run 1h long-run and monitor model-quality evals for any subtle score drift.
mike: add regression alert on eval set and postpone global rollout until 99.9% pass for 30m.
eva: noted. action items: sophia to open PR with tests, cheng to run long-run, mike to own rollout gating, ashley to monitor infra metrics.
ashley: thanks all — will post final perf dump in #eng-ml when long-run finishes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary canary-7292: 1h run complete. token-drop avg=0.06% p95=225ms. No eval regressions observed.
ashley: marking resolved for now. will keep watch for 24h. (reaction :eyes:)
